descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Experience: 5+ years in Mobile Development
 Languages: German and English 
 Job Description 
 We are looking for an experienced Android Developer with strong Kotlin skills and a solid background in mobile application development. You will contribute to building and maintaining high-quality Android applications, collaborating with cross-functional teams in an international environment.
 Responsibilities 
Develop, maintain, and improve Android applications using Kotlin.
Integrate REST APIs and connect mobile applications with backend services.
Handle API requests, responses, error handling, and network-related issues.
Collaborate with backend developers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders.
Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to code reviews and testing.
Participate in technical discussions and Agile team activities.
 Requirements 
Minimum 5 years of experience in mobile development , preferably focused on Android.
Strong knowledge of Kotlin and Android development fundamentals.
Experience with REST API integrations and backend connectivity.
Familiarity with Android architecture patterns, Kotlin Coroutines, and modern Android development tools.
Good problem-solving and communication skills.
Professional working proficiency in German and English .
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with Jetpack Compose, Retrofit, and OkHttp.
Familiarity with automated testing and CI/CD processes.
 Collaboration Model: flexible – Employment Contract (CIM) or B2B.
